# Vendored libraries
Download each library once, save it here with its version in the file name, and list it below.

| Library | Version | File | License |
|---|---|---|---|
| pdf-lib | 1.17.1 | pdf-lib-1.17.1.min.js | MIT |
| pdf.js | 4.10.38 | pdfjs-4.10.38.min.mjs, pdfjs-4.10.38.worker.min.mjs | Apache-2.0 |
| fflate | 0.8.2 | fflate-0.8.2.min.js | MIT |
| qrcode-generator | 1.4.4 | qrcode-generator-1.4.4.js | MIT |
| EFF short word list | 2016-09-08 | eff-short-wordlist-1.txt | CC BY 3.0 |
| SheetJS | 0.18.5 | xlsx-0.18.5.full.min.js | Apache-2.0 |

The EFF short word list is from [EFF's passphrase word list page](https://www.eff.org/deeplinks/2016/07/new-wordlists-random-passphrases). It is used only for local passphrase generation. Attribution is required by its CC BY license.
